impact_scope.description: The existing meshopt_generateNormals callable changes how adjacent degenerate and nondegenerate faces are grouped: internally computed face normals now carry a degeneracy identity, and merging requires matching identities. Its public signature and caller-controlled parameters are unchanged.

evidence: S0 declares meshopt_generateNormals at src/tangentspace.cpp:651 with the same caller-visible signature.
H0 calls meshlet, codec, and simplification APIs but contains no call to meshopt_generateNormals.
S1 declares meshopt_generateNormals at src/tangentspace.cpp:653 with an unchanged caller-visible signature.
The production diff only changes internal normal computation and grouping; unchanged H0 still contains no call to meshopt_generateNormals.

new_harness_obligation.description: S1 does not require H0 to add a different entry point, argument, buffer, configuration, lifecycle transition, or call sequence. Reaching either version begins with the same already-omitted meshopt_generateNormals call and its existing inputs.
evidence: The meshopt_generateNormals declaration and parameters are identical in S0 and S1.
The added Normal.id field is computed internally from face geometry and is not caller-supplied.
The new fi.id == fj.id merge condition is internal behavior within the existing callable.

reason: The anchored semantic unit is the existing meshopt_generateNormals API, specifically its handling of degenerate-face normal grouping. H0 omitted this same callable before and after the commit, while the commit changes only behavior reached through its unchanged inputs. Therefore the same-scope exposure gap is true in both snapshots, yielding UNCHANGED and no fuzz-harness maintenance need.
